name: ASR Microelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: ASR Microelectronics Co., Ltd., a platform chip company, manufactures and sells wireless communication chips and ultra-large-scale integrated chip products in China. The company offers cellular baseband chips, including 5G, smartphone and wearable chip, IoT chip, mobile intelligent terminal, and mobile broadband chip; and non-cellular IoT chips, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and combo chip, as well as LPWAN SoC for intelligent payment. It also provides chip customization for artificial intelligence algorithms, the internet, big data, and industrial control applications.
